resources.string: A binary clock as a live wallpaper for your home and lock screen.
Binary clock showing hours and minutes
Wallpaper only – the widget updates once a minute
Also shows the time or place values as numbers
Widget: long-press your home screen → Widgets → Binary-Clock.
Update the widget on the minute
To flip exactly at every full minute, the widget needs the “Alarms & reminders” permission. Without it, it may lag behind by a few minutes.
Each column is one digit of HH:MM:SS. From bottom to top the dots are worth 1, 2, 4 and 8 – add up the lit ones.
Each row is one number: hours, minutes, seconds. From right to left the places are worth 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and 32 – add up the lit ones.
